scripts.build:check: npm run guard && tsc -b && vite build --outDir /tmp/dashboard-build-check --emptyOutDir
scripts.build: npm run guard && echo '!! vite build writes dashboard/dist — that IS the LIVE served dashboard. To test a build safely use: npm run build:check' && tsc -b && vite build && { S=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); if ! OUT=$(git status --porcelain -- . 2>&1) || [ -n "$OUT" ]; then S="${S}-dirty"; fi; echo "$S" > dist/BUILD_SHA; }
scripts.test: tsx --test src/lib/*.test.ts && for f in src/lib/*.test.mjs; do node --experimental-strip-types "$f" || exit 1; done
